title: Cadet Watch
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Cadet Watch and the helm marks Cadet Yard. Do: Close on Cadet Yard. The training patrol hails paint rounds before live guns. The ice ring is a counted cut and the salvage is bad on purpose. Finish: come inside Cadet Yard's shell. The Compact writes standing. A shot in the green still goes on the slate. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
